title: A PDF table places a page-tall `rowspan` piece whole, aligns every cell to the top, and draws no row or group background or border.
text: Closing it splits a `rowspan` piece across pages, sizes a table without a `width` to its content, honours `vertical-align`, draws a row's and a group's own background and borders, puts a cell's `data-mark` and `string-set` on its own page, and lays out a `display: table` element in a row as a table (`rule:core-classes/pdf-tables-across-pages`).
